title: Homebrew cask audit refuses to load cask from untrusted local tap
error_pattern:
Refusing to load cask local/aspire/aspire from untrusted tap local/aspire.
Run `brew trust --cask local/aspire/aspire` or `brew trust local/aspire` to trust it.

occurrences.job: Tests / Prepare Homebrew installer artifacts / Prepare Homebrew cask
